== Card image wording (Batch B25, held for Bill) ==
The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip [[:File:VB5-75E-Kashyyyk.png]] and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) read “Once per turn, if Kashyyyk was your starting location, may ▼ a Kashyyyk site.” The Players Committee card image [[:File:VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif]] reads “… if this was your starting location, may ▼ a Kashyyyk site.” The PC card data (used by GEMP until now) has “if this was your starting location, may deploy one Kashyyyk site”. The page keeps the slip and Master List text; the card image wording waits on a ruling. The card image also prints the Dark Side text (“Total ability of 6 or more required for you to draw battle destiny here.”), which the slip, a Light Side slip, does not reprint; it stays on the page.
